conditions.description: The conditions of the filter as a JSON object. Please note that a maximum of 16 conditions is allowed per filter and `date` values must be supplied in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. It requires a minimum structure as follows: `{"glue":"and","conditions":[{"glue":"and","conditions": [CONDITION_OBJECTS]},{"glue":"or","conditions":[CONDITION_OBJECTS]}]}`. Replace `CONDITION_OBJECTS` with JSON objects of the following structure: `{"object":"","field_id":"", "operator":"","value":"", "extra_value":""}` or leave the array empty. Depending on the object type you should use another API endpoint to get `field_id`.
